name: Kondou Isami
source:
Chief of the Shinsengumi.
He is responsible for the Shinsengumi. Despite having great swordsmanship, he is very sympathetic and easily moved to tears. He believes a warrior's true duty is to serve the shogun.

[Taken from [url=http://ideafintl.com/hakuoki-kyoto/home.php]official english site[/url]]
